pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Es geht" mean as an answer to "Wie geht's?" (1 mark)
   A. It is so-so
   B. It is very good
   C. It is goodbye
   D. It is very bad

2. What does "der Onkel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. uncle
   B. family
   C. brothers and sisters
   D. mother

3. Which sound repeats most in "Montags macht mir meine muntere Mutter mittags meistens Mus"? (1 mark)
   A. k
   B. sch
   C. m
   D. z

4. Which day comes right after Dienstag? (1 mark)
   A. Freitag
   B. Mittwoch
   C. Samstag
   D. Montag

5. What is the "ch" sound like in "Kuchen"? (1 mark)
   A. ts as in cats
   B. k as in cake
   C. a breathy sound at the back of the throat
   D. sh as in ship

6. What number is "vierzehn"? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 17
   C. 12
   D. 9

7. What does "der Saft" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. banana
   B. juice
   C. cabbage or kale
   D. apple

8. What does "die Zwiebel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. egg
   C. onion
   D. watermelon

9. What does "das Frühstück" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sugar
   B. breakfast
   C. cabbage or kale
   D. juice

10. How is the word "heiß" pronounced? (1 mark)
   A. like hice
   B. like hiss
   C. like hate
   D. like hoyss

11. What does "spielen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to play
   B. to hear
   C. to help
   D. to sing

12. What does "Ja" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. sorry, excuse me
   C. please
   D. good night

13. What does "Entschuldigung" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. see you tomorrow
   B. good night
   C. good day (daytime greeting)
   D. sorry, excuse me

14. How is the letter A named in German? (1 mark)
   A. eff
   B. yot
   C. pay
   D. ah

15. What does "das Bett" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. door
   B. bed
   C. bathroom
   D. sofa

16. What does "scharf" mean when we talk about a knife? (1 mark)
   A. cold
   B. small
   C. sharp
   D. heavy

17. Which little word goes with the noun "Tür"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. die
   D. den

18. What does "Nein, danke" mean? (1 mark)
   A. See you soon
   B. Good night
   C. Yes, please
   D. No, thank you

19. Which German word is the number 20? (1 mark)
   A. zwölf
   B. achtzehn
   C. drei
   D. zwanzig

20. Which month comes right after "Januar"? (1 mark)
   A. Februar
   B. April
   C. November
   D. Mai

21. What does "das Geschenk" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. candle
   B. birthday
   C. balloon
   D. present

22. What does "der Käse" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. carrot
   B. cheese
   C. juice
   D. bread

23. What does "die Tomate" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. breakfast
   B. fish
   C. tomato
   D. banana

24. What does "der Nebel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thunderstorm
   B. cloud
   C. sky
   D. fog

25. What is the plural of "die Wolke"? (1 mark)
   A. die Wolker
   B. die Wolke
   C. die Wolkes
   D. die Wolken

26. Which form completes "Ich ___ neun Jahre alt"? (1 mark)
   A. ist
   B. sind
   C. bin
   D. bist

27. Which sentence is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Mein Vater ist groß.
   B. Mein Vater sind groß.
   C. Mein Vater bin groß.
   D. Mein Vater bist groß.

28. Which German word or phrase means "parents"? (1 mark)
   A. das Kind
   B. die Geschwister
   C. die Eltern
   D. die Familie

29. How is a Rückendiktat done? (1 mark)
   A. You write on the board
   B. You copy from a book
   C. You read aloud
   D. A partner writes letters on your back and you write the word

30. Which German word means "to read"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. trinken
   B. hören
   C. tanzen
   D. lesen

31. What does "der dritte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. first
   B. eighth
   C. third
   D. second

32. What does "der zweite" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. seventh
   B. first
   C. third
   D. second

33. What does "der zehnte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fifth
   B. second
   C. fourth
   D. tenth

34. Which German word or phrase means "onion"? (1 mark)
   A. die Milch
   B. die Zwiebel
   C. die Karotte
   D. der Saft

35. Which food group does "die Zwiebel" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Obst
   B. das Fleisch
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Gemüse

36. Which food group does "die Orange" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Obst
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Fleisch

37. What is the plural of "die Hand"? (1 mark)
   A. die Hände
   B. die Hands
   C. die Hande
   D. die Hander

38. Which German word or phrase means "head"? (1 mark)
   A. der Rücken
   B. das Haar
   C. das Gesicht
   D. der Kopf

39. Which German word or phrase means "neck"? (1 mark)
   A. der Finger
   B. der Hals
   C. die Hand
   D. der Zahn

40. Which little word goes with the noun "Wolke"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. den
   D. das

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain the trick to decide between ie and ei when you write. (2 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: son, mouth, door, radio, nose. (5 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lunch, carrot. (2 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: family, cabbage or kale, toilet, fog, bed. (5 marks)

45. Give two safety rules for sending messages online. (2 marks)

46. Write two sentences about healthy food and one about unhealthy food in German. (3 marks)

47. Write these numbers in German: 14, 16, 18. (3 marks)

48. Name two ways to make the kitchen safer at home. (2 marks)

49. Write the German words with der, die or das for: room, sun. (2 marks)

50. Say what the tongue twister "Montags macht mir meine muntere Mutter mittags meistens Mus" means in English. (2 marks)

51. Write the German names of these months: January, February, March. (3 marks)

52. List three members of the wider family in German with their articles. (3 marks)

53. Write the German words with der, die or das for: eye, neck, friend, uncle. (4 marks)

54. Explain when to use "mein" and when to use "meine". Give one example of each. (3 marks)

55. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tummy, apple, cheese. (3 marks)

56. Write the four punctuation marks with their German names. (4 marks)

57. Write the seven days of the week in German in order, starting with Monday. (4 marks)

58. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knife, balloon. (2 marks)

59. Write three words from a Kenyan greeting or from German that must begin with a capital letter, and say why. (3 marks)

60. Read: "Heute ist Samstag. Vater liest im Wohnzimmer. Mutter kocht in der Küche." Give the gist. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — It is so-so
   Es geht means it is okay, so-so.

2. A — uncle
   der Onkel means uncle.

3. C — m
   Nearly every word starts with m.

4. B — Mittwoch
   After Dienstag comes Mittwoch.

5. C — a breathy sound at the back of the throat
   After u the ch is a scratchy breath sound.

6. A — 14
   vierzehn is the number 14.

7. B — juice
   der Saft means juice.

8. C — onion
   die Zwiebel means onion.

9. B — breakfast
   das Frühstück means breakfast.

10. A — like hice
   ei sounds like eye and ß is a strong s.

11. A — to play
   spielen means to play.

12. A — yes
   Ja means yes.

13. D — sorry, excuse me
   Entschuldigung means sorry, excuse me.

14. D — ah
   In German the letter A is called ah.

15. B — bed
   das Bett means bed.

16. C — sharp
   scharf means sharp.

17. C — die
   It is die Tür, so the little word is die.

18. D — No, thank you
   nein = no and danke = thank you.

19. D — zwanzig
   20 in German is zwanzig.

20. A — Februar
   After Januar comes Februar.

21. D — present
   das Geschenk means present.

22. B — cheese
   der Käse means cheese.

23. C — tomato
   die Tomate means tomato.

24. D — fog
   der Nebel means fog.

25. D — die Wolken
   The plural of die Wolke is die Wolken.

26. C — bin
   ich goes with bin.

27. A — Mein Vater ist groß.
   Vater is he, so we use ist.

28. C — die Eltern
   parents in German is die Eltern.

29. D — A partner writes letters on your back and you write the word
   Rücken means back.

30. D — lesen
   to read in German is lesen.

31. C — third
   der dritte means third.

32. D — second
   der zweite means second.

33. D — tenth
   der zehnte means tenth.

34. B — die Zwiebel
   onion in German is die Zwiebel.

35. D — das Gemüse
   die Zwiebel belongs to das Gemüse.

36. B — das Obst
   die Orange belongs to das Obst.

37. A — die Hände
   The plural of die Hand is die Hände.

38. D — der Kopf
   head in German is der Kopf.

39. B — der Hals
   neck in German is der Hals.

40. B — die
   It is die Wolke, so the little word is die.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: If you hear ee, write ie; if you hear eye, write ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Sohn, der Mund, die Tür, das Radio, die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Mittagessen, die Karotte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Familie, der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Write only to people you know; do not share private information; ask an adult first.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Obst ist gesund. Wasser ist gesund. Limonade ist ungesund.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: vierzehn, sechzehn, achtzehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep hot pots and matches away from small children; never leave the cooker alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Zimmer, die Sonne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Mondays my lively mother usually makes me mush at midday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Mondays and mother, 1 mark for the mush at midday.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Januar, Februar, März.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: die Oma, der Opa, der Onkel, die Tante.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Auge, der Hals, der Freund, der Onkel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use mein with der and das nouns (mein Vater) and meine with die nouns and plurals (meine Mutter).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule and 1 mark for correct examples.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: . der Punkt, , das Komma, ? das Fragezeichen, ! das Ausrufezeichen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark with its name.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all seven correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Messer, der Luftballon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen, Amina, Kenia. Nouns, names and the first word of a sentence begin with capitals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for examples, 1 mark for nouns, 1 mark for names.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is Saturday. Father is reading in the living room and Mother is cooking in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three facts.
